concept: Inked Bandra: a hand-illustrated 3D reel. Mumbai island and real OSM buildings, a generated storefront and 3D coffee and bakes all run through one ink-and-cel pass (wobbled outlines, banded shading, hatching, paper grain). Captions are hard-shadow paper tags, scenes change with an ink wipe.

dimensions.palette: deep teal ground, pale paper grey, ink green, whitewash; food keeps its natural colour
dimensions.fonts: Fraunces headlines (italic accents) + DM Mono labels, two faces only
dimensions.opening: 3D Mumbai island descent into real Bandra buildings
dimensions.camera: continuous descent, push-in on image, pour swoop to top-down
motion_device: tilted paper tags with word stagger
dimensions.texture: ink outlines, cel bands, diagonal hatching, paper grain
dimensions.sound: generated foley, no music, no voiceover

concept: Stage Night: Prithvi Cafe, Juhu as a theatre curtain-up. Curtain opens on the Bombay Cafe Map logo, a single moving spotlight lights a dark 3D Mumbai map down to the real Prithvi compound, a bulb marquee lights the cafe name, a theatre flip-board rolls to 1978, three dishes sit in pools of light, and the curtain drops on the end card.

dimensions.palette: aubergine ground #1d1226, oxblood curtain #6e1f33, cool white #f4f6fb, acid lime accent #c6f24a (no orange, no cream)
dimensions.fonts: condensed grotesk marquee headlines + IBM Plex Mono labels, two faces only
dimensions.opening: logo-first inside an opening curtain, then spotlight-follow map zoom from the island shape to the Prithvi compound
dimensions.transition: spotlight hand-off: the light pool moves to the next subject, scenes never cut through black
dimensions.camera: tilt-down descent over the map, slow push-ins on food, hard drop for the end card
dimensions.layout: each scene differs: centred stage, left-weighted marquee, split flip-board, three-beat food row, full-bleed curtain end card
dimensions.texture: velvet curtain, bulb glow, 3D extruded OSM buildings with a detail pass, hand-modelled Prithvi compound
dimensions.sound: curtain rustle, bulb clicks, flip-board clatter, soft pad, slow voice at most 2.2 words per second, no tea pouring
dimensions.ending: curtain drops, stacked Bombay Cafe Map lockup with @bombaycafemap and bombaycafemap.com, Prithvi Cafe at lockup size, held 3 s

concept: Acquisition Lore x The Bakery Price: 'The Paper Trail' explainer. The illustrated Host (poses H00-H04 from the brand guide) walks through a hypothetical bakery's numbers on a deal-desk: receipt slips, a strike-through villain line, thud stamps and orange marker marks. Every animation fires on a word time from the voice engine (data/cues.json), including count-ups, strikes, stamps, pose changes and nods.

dimensions.palette: Acquisition Lore brand guide: Lore Black #0A0A0A, Lore White, Notch Orange #D3743E (one focus per frame), Paper #F3EEE6, Graphite #1E1E1E, Smoke #75747A, Ember #A4501F for small text on paper. Supplied by the brand guide, so locked (the orange + paper pairing is the client's own identity, not Claude branding).
dimensions.fonts: Archivo 900/700 headlines, Instrument Serif Italic accent word, JetBrains Mono labels (brand guide 4.1)
dimensions.opening: hook on black with the illustrated Host pointing, full headline and the big number visible in frame 1 (the cover), marker underline drawn on the spoken number
dimensions.transition: paper slide, 240 ms, inside the 0.45 s voice gap; the split scene slides its two halves in from opposite sides
dimensions.camera: flat desk-top layout, no camera move; Host breathes and nods on keywords
dimensions.layout: asymmetric: big numerals left, Host bleeding off the bottom corner, receipt slips tilted 2-3 degrees
motion_device: marker underline and circle on twos
count-up and count-down on spoken numbers
Host pose pop and nod on keywords
dimensions.texture: monochrome film grain on every ground (shifts on twos), torn-edge paper slips with soft shadow
dimensions.sound: word-synced foley (tick, stamp thud, pen scratch, paper slide, tape), minimal warm lo-fi pad and pluck ducked under the voice, Kokoro male voice at word-timed cues
dimensions.ending: close card: full wordmark held over 2 s, Don't start one. Buy one., orange DM LORE box with thud, Host with hand on chest
